name: 単語の説明を読み削除を取り消す
prompt: Redesign the existing Japanese word-definition screen as a single 390×730 portrait image. Match the native preview exactly in canvas, crop, content, positions, sizes and hierarchy. The native Japanese preview is authoritative for all copy and layout. The attached user image is palette preference only; do not copy its geometry. Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for both the page canvas and the word card. Keep a thin neutral gray card outline (#E2E2E2). Remove all lavender, cream, mint, blue or other tinted surface fills. Do not add gradients, shaded color washes, shadows, or extra panels. Preserve the dark charcoal deletion banner and its exact Japanese text and placement. Preserve the exact Japanese copy and punctuation: 単語を削除しました; 元に戻す; ねこ; 名詞; ネコ科に属する、; 人と暮らす小さな動物。; 「灰色のねこと暮らしています。」; 12%の進み具合; 削除. Keep the speaker control and its existing green symbol, the 12% progress bar with a neutral gray track and a flat solid green completed segment, and the gray delete action. Use only flat solid green for the existing active cues, with no green tint surfaces. Keep typography, line breaks, spacing, border thickness, and large empty area inside the card aligned to the native preview. No added status bar, icons, artwork, or copy. Do not translate or alter any labels.
reviewNotes: White/neutral surfaces and solid green cues achieved; card bounds, text scale and pure-white flatness need one targeted correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
